# Kevin Jose — Photography, Film, Branding & Digital Ads (Dubai, UAE)

> Kevin Jose is a Dubai-based photographer and filmmaker who also builds brands and runs paid digital marketing ads for businesses across the UAE (Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah and the Northern Emirates). Working since 2018, shooting on Sony FX3 and A7R V.

## Services
- Photography & videography: brand films, commercial, product, food and lifestyle photography, real estate photo and video, weddings and events.
- Brand building: strategy and positioning, logo and visual identity, brand guidelines, tone of voice and mood, brand photography, website and ecommerce builds.
- Digital marketing ads: campaigns on Instagram/Facebook (Meta), TikTok, Google/YouTube and Snapchat targeted to UAE audiences, with ad creative shot and edited in-house.
- Gear rental: cameras, lenses, lighting and grip in Dubai, day and weekend rates.

## Selected brand work
- Layla Flowers (Dubai florist): full brand from name and logo to product photography and an ecommerce website.
- Sama Beirut (butchery & food brand, Beirut): identity, guidelines, food photography and a website with online ordering.

## Brand building guides
- [Brand Building in Dubai: The Complete Guide](https://www.kevinjosephotography.com/guides/brand-building-guide-dubai/): What brand building actually involves for a Dubai business: strategy, name, logo, colours, typography, photography, packaging and website, in the right order.
- [Logo Design: What Makes a Good Logo](https://www.kevinjosephotography.com/guides/logo-design-guide/): How to brief, design and test a logo that works on everything from Instagram to shop signage, with the files every UAE business should receive.
- [How to Choose Your Brand Colours](https://www.kevinjosephotography.com/guides/brand-colours-guide/): How to choose brand colours that suit your audience, stand out from competitors and stay readable, with palette structure and colour codes explained.
- [Brand Photography: How to Plan a Shoot](https://www.kevinjosephotography.com/guides/brand-photography-guide/): How to plan brand photography that matches your identity: mood boards, shot lists, product, lifestyle and team photos, and where to use them.
- [Brand Guidelines: What to Include](https://www.kevinjosephotography.com/guides/brand-guidelines-guide/): What brand guidelines are, what every brand book should include, and how they keep your logo, colours, fonts, photography and tone consistent.
- [Packaging Design for Small Businesses](https://www.kevinjosephotography.com/guides/packaging-design-guide/): How to design branded packaging that protects, sells and gets shared: bags, boxes, labels, ribbons, tags and cards for food, gifting and retail brands.

## Case studies
- [Layla Flowers](https://www.kevinjosephotography.com/case-studies/layla-flowers/): How the Layla Flowers brand was built from zero in Dubai: name, logo, colours, guidelines, wrapping paper, ribbon, tags, product and lifestyle photography and an ecommerce website.
- [Sama Beirut](https://www.kevinjosephotography.com/case-studies/sama-beirut/): How the Sama Beirut butchery and food brand was designed: cleaver-and-cedar logo, signage, delivery van livery, packaging, food photography and a website with online ordering.
